parameters.name: ConnectorIds
parameters.description: An array of up to 100 ConnectorIDs.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Valid values: 1 to 10,000.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the connector. The name must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 1,000.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The connection status of the connector. Valid values:

- **Online**

- **Offline**

parameters.name: SwitchStatus
parameters.description:
The state of the connector instance. Valid values:

- **Enabled**

- **Disabled**
